# App Intelligence Research Agent — Dataset & Case Study

> Evidence-backed integration & buildability audit of 100 applications across 10 categories for Composio.

## Files
- index.html: Interactive static case study with full dataset embedded in <script type="application/json" id="dataset">.
- apps.json: Complete claim-level JSON records for all 100 apps (final pass), including verbatim quotes, evidence URLs, verification loop ledgers (L1-L6), and deterministic buildability breakdowns.
- apps.csv: Flat one-row-per-app table with scores, verdicts, buckets, auth methods, access tiers, production gates, MCP status, Composio toolkit coverage, and blockers.
- llms.txt: This machine-readable overview.

## Schema Summary (apps.json)
Each item in apps.json is an AppRecord:
- app_id (1-100), app, pass ("final"), record_confidence ("high" | "medium" | "low")
- claims: 16 claim objects (category, description, auth_methods, credential_access, production_gate, api_type, api_breadth, mcp_official, mcp_third_party, free_tier_or_sandbox, webhooks, official_sdks, rate_limit_note, open_source_self_host, main_blocker, docs_url). Each claim carries value, evidence[] (url, quote, source_tier), extractor_confidence, and verification (status, loops[L1..L6], notes).
- composio_toolkit: value ("available" | "unavailable"), slug, source (deterministic catalog lookup, never LLM-guessed).
- buildability: score (0-10), verdict ("easy" | "moderate" | "difficult" | "blocked"), breakdown (5 anchored 0-2 dimensions with driver text), commercial_gate (bool), bucket ("easy_win" | "moderate" | "needs_outreach" | "technically_blocked").

## Opportunity Buckets (N=100)
- Easy wins: 64 (8 without a Composio toolkit)
- Moderate effort: 23
- Needs outreach / BD (commercial gate): 12
- Technically blocked: 1

## Key Findings
- 56 of 100 apps let a developer get credentials for free, but 16 of those still need an app review, marketplace listing, or partner program before you can serve many customers.
- 86 of 100 apps publish an official MCP server. 14 of those are not in the Composio catalog yet — ready coverage opportunities.
- 64 of 100 apps look ready to integrate today (score 8–10, no partnership gate). 8 of those are still missing from Composio.
- 12 of 100 apps require a partnership, sales contact, or partner program before you can build — 5 of those are not in Composio yet. The densest category is Finance and Fintech (4 apps).
- The most common blocker is getting developer credentials (paid plans, admin approval, or partner signup) (48 of 100 apps, 48%).
- 91 of 100 apps expose a REST API and 74 support OAuth 2.0 (37 of those still document an extra gate before production). 64 apps offer two or more ways to authenticate.

## Accuracy & Verification Methodology
- Golden set: 20 stratified apps (2 per category, 120 evaluated claims across 6 fields), human-confirmed from primary documentation.
- Frozen scoring rules SHA-256: 8d32f4df9c1988c6bef1029cd7ca24f4e724d102ac1c59edbf3297cf633ca4d3
- First-pass automated accuracy (Pass 1, raw research agent): 52.5% (63/120 claims)
- Final automated verification accuracy (Pass 2, L1-L6 checks + independent Meta Muse Spark verifier): 54.17% (65/120 claims, +1.67 percentage points; introduced 3 regressions and filled 6 unknowns incorrectly)
- Post-review corrected-sample agreement (Final): 100.0% agreement with human labels on that same 120-claim sample after 55 human corrections (quality-control step, NOT independently measured model accuracy; independent post-correction accuracy was not measured)
- Holdout: skipped_per_prd_cut_line_1 — 5 apps were kept out of the hand-checked sample (Zoho CRM, Vonage, Squarespace, Paygent Connect, Grain). They are still in the full 100-app dataset; only the accuracy score above was measured on the 20 apps I labelled by hand.
